title: Benchmarking the Robustness of Foundation Models for Mammography under Domain Shift
abstract: arXiv:2607.10358v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Foundation models are increasingly used as image feature extractors for mammography, but their robustness under external domain shift remains unclear. We benchmark 15 foundation-model backbones across breast density, BI-RADS severity, and cancer status using a unified frozen-backbone linear-probe protocol, training on 3 source datasets and evaluating on 12 task-compatible out-of-distribution (OOD) datasets after label harmonization. Mammography-specific vision-language models (Mammo-FM and MaMA) provide the strongest mean OOD performance, but robustness is not explained by mammography exposure alone. DINOv3 remains a competitive vision-only baseline, and mammography-adapted pretraining does not consistently improve generalization. Dataset-level analysis further shows that even leading models show heterogeneous performance across datasets. Feature-space inspection reveals that useful representations can preserve clinical signal

translated_title: 基础模型在乳腺X线摄影中域偏移下的鲁棒性基准测试
translated_abstract: arXiv:2607.10358v2 公告类型：替换-交叉 摘要：基础模型越来越多地被用作乳腺X线摄影的图像特征提取器，但它们在外部域偏移下的鲁棒性仍不清楚。我们使用统一的冻结骨干线性探针协议，在3个源数据集上训练，并在标签统一后的12个任务兼容分布外（OOD）数据集上评估，对15个基础模型骨干在乳腺密度、BI-RADS严重程度和癌症状态方面进行了基准测试。乳腺X线摄影专用的视觉-语言模型（Mammo-FM和MaMA）提供了最强的平均OOD性能，但鲁棒性并不仅仅由乳腺X线摄影暴露解释。DINOv3仍是一个有竞争力的纯视觉基线，而乳腺X线摄影适应的预训练并未一致地提高泛化能力。数据集层面的分析进一步表明，即使领先的模型在不同数据集上也表现出异质性性能。特征空间检查揭示，有用的表示可以保留临床信号。
tldr: 本研究对15个基础模型在乳腺X线摄影域偏移下的鲁棒性进行基准测试，发现专用视觉-语言模型表现最佳，但鲁棒性并非仅由领域暴露决定，且适应预训练未一致提升泛化。
en_tdlr: This study benchmarks 15 foundation models for mammography under domain shift, finding that specialized vision-language models perform best, but robustness is not solely explained by domain exposure, and adapted pretraining does not consistently improve generalization.
